appName.description: The extension's name. The same in every language.

appDesc.message: View, edit, delete and block cookies. There are no ads, and nothing you do leaves your computer.
appDesc.description: The summary under the name in the Chrome Web Store and on chrome://extensions. 132 characters at most.

page_loading.description: Shown for a moment while the popup reads the site's cookies.

page_gateHeading.description: Heading of the first screen, before the user has let cookieZ see websites. Short.

page_gateIntro.message: Chrome only shows an extension a site's cookies once it has access to that site. cookieZ needs access to the websites you visit.
page_gateIntro.description: First screen: why cookieZ asks for access to websites.

page_gateAfter.message: Then you can see, edit, delete, block and export any site's cookies.
page_gateAfter.description: First screen: what the user can do once access is given.

page_gatePrivacy.message: Access is used only while cookieZ is open. Nothing is sent anywhere: cookieZ makes no network requests and has no analytics.
page_gatePrivacy.description: First screen, in small grey text: the privacy promise. cookieZ is the product name.

page_gateGrant.description: First screen: the button that asks Chrome for access to websites. Short: a button label.

page_blockedHeading.description: Heading when the current page is one Chrome doesn't let extensions read, such as chrome:// pages or the Chrome Web Store.

page_blockedHint.message: Open a normal website and click the icon again.
page_blockedHint.description: Under that heading: what to do instead. 'The icon' is cookieZ's button in Chrome's toolbar.

page_errorHeading.description: Heading of the screen shown when something unexpected fails.

page_retry.description: Button on the error screen that tries again. Short: a button label.

page_reportOpenTitle.message: See what this site has stored, and what's worth checking

page_reportOpen.description: Link-style button beside the cookie count at the top, opening the site report. Short.

page_changesOpenTitle.description: Tooltip on the link that reads like '3 changes', beside the cookie count.

page_rulesOpenTitle.message: Choose which cookies this site may set
page_rulesOpenTitle.description: Tooltip on the Block button at the top.

page_rulesOpen.description: Button at the top that opens the screen for blocking this site's cookies. Very short: it sits beside an icon in a crowded bar.

page_add.description: Button at the top that opens the editor for a new cookie. Short: a button label.

page_refreshTitle.description: Tooltip on the refresh icon button.

page_refresh.description: Name of the refresh icon button, for screen readers. Short.

page_help.description: 'Help': the name and tooltip of the ? icon button, and the heading of the Help screen. Short.

page_more.description: Name and tooltip of the ... icon button that opens the More menu. Short.

page_themeGroup.description: Name of the pair of light/dark theme buttons in the More menu. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_themeLightTitle.description: Tooltip on the sun icon that switches to the light theme.

page_themeLight.description: Name of the sun icon button that switches to the light theme. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_themeDarkTitle.description: Tooltip on the moon icon that switches to the dark theme.

page_themeDark.description: Name of the moon icon button that switches to the dark theme. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_openInSidePanel.description: More menu item: opens cookieZ in Chrome's side panel. Short: a menu item.

page_openInTab.description: More menu item: opens cookieZ in a browser tab of its own. Short: a menu item.

page_whatsNewOk.description: Button that closes the one-off 'What's new' line. Short: a button label.

page_reviewAsk.message: Glad cookieZ is useful. A review in the Chrome Web Store helps other people find it.
page_reviewAsk.description: A line shown at most twice, asking for a review. cookieZ is the product name.

page_reviewOpen.description: Link-style button that opens cookieZ's page in the Chrome Web Store to leave a review. Short: a button label.

page_reviewLater.description: Link-style button that hides the review request. Short: a button label.

page_searchLabel.description: Name of the search box. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_searchPlaceholder.message: Search, or try name: or domain:
page_searchPlaceholder.description: Grey hint inside the empty search box. Keep 'name:' and 'domain:' in English: they are typed search prefixes.

page_filtersGroup.description: Name of the row of filter buttons under the search box. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_filterSession.description: Filter button: show only session cookies (deleted when the browser closes). Short: a small filter button.

page_filterKept.description: Filter button: show only cookies the user has marked as Kept, which cookieZ never deletes. Use the same word as the 'Kept' badge. Short: a small filter button.

page_filterSoon.description: Filter button: show only cookies that expire soon. Short: a small filter button.

page_filterLarge.description: Filter button: show only large cookies, close to Chrome's size limit. Short: a small filter button.

page_filterKnownTitle.message: Cookies with a name in the Open Cookie Database. A guess from the name only.
page_filterKnownTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Known' filter. The Open Cookie Database is the name of a public list; leave it in English.

page_filterKnown.description: Filter button: show only cookies whose name is in a list of known cookies. Short: a small filter button.

page_filterNotSecureTitle.message: Cookies without Secure, so they're also sent over plain HTTP
page_filterNotSecureTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Not Secure' filter. Secure is the cookie attribute's name; keep it in English.

page_filterNotSecure.description: Filter button: cookies without the Secure attribute. Keep 'Secure' in English. Short: a small filter button.

page_filterReadableTitle.message: Cookies without HttpOnly, so the page's scripts can read them
page_filterReadableTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Readable by scripts' filter. HttpOnly is the cookie attribute's name; keep it in English.

page_filterReadable.description: Filter button: cookies the page's JavaScript can read (no HttpOnly). Short: a small filter button.

page_filterSameSiteNoneTitle.message: Cookies with SameSite None, sent when another site loads something from this one
page_filterSameSiteNoneTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'SameSite None' filter. Keep 'SameSite None' in English: it is the attribute and its value.

page_searchClearTitle.message: Clear the search and the filters
page_searchClearTitle.description: Tooltip on the Clear button beside the search box.

page_searchClear.description: Button that empties the search box and turns off the filters. Short: a button label.

page_deletePanelHeading.description: Heading of the delete and export area. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_scopesGroup.description: Name of the list of choices for which cookies to delete. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_scopePicked.description: Choice of which cookies to delete or export: only the ones ticked in the table.

page_scopeMatches.description: Choice of which cookies to delete or export: only the ones the search shows.

page_scopePage.description: Choice of which cookies to delete or export: the ones the current page gets. Short.

page_scopeDomain.description: Choice of which cookies to delete or export: the whole domain, subdomains included.

page_scopeAll.description: Choice of which cookies to delete or export: every site in the browser. Short.

page_scopeAllNote.description: Small note beside 'All sites', starting lower case, explaining it.

page_scopeCounting.description: Shown for a moment while the number of cookies about to be deleted is counted.

page_delete.description: Button that starts deleting the chosen cookies; it asks first, hence the dots. Short: a button label.

page_export.description: Button that opens the export screen; hence the dots. Short: a button label.

page_importTitle.message: Add cookies from a JSON or cookies.txt export
page_importTitle.description: Tooltip on the Import button. JSON and cookies.txt are file formats; keep them.

page_import.description: Button that opens the import screen. Short: a button label.

page_dataTitle.message: Can't log in? Delete this site's cookies, clear everything else it has stored, and reload it
page_dataTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Clear and reload...' button.

page_dataButton.description: Button that deletes this site's cookies and other stored data, then reloads the page. It asks first, hence the dots. Short: a button label.

page_confirmDelete.description: Button that confirms a delete, after a question like 'Delete 6 cookies?'. Short: a button label.

page_cancel.description: Button that cancels a question or leaves a form without saving. Used on several screens. Short: a button label.

page_dataYesReload.description: Button that confirms clearing the site's data and then reloads the page. Short: a button label.

page_dataYes.description: Button that confirms clearing the site's data without reloading the page. Short: a button label.

page_pickedGroup.description: Name of the bar of actions for the cookies ticked in the table. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_pickedKeep.description: Button: mark the ticked cookies as Kept, so cookieZ never deletes them. Short: a button label.

page_pickedUnkeep.description: Button: stop keeping the ticked cookies, so deletes include them again. Short: a button label.

page_expireIn.description: Label before the buttons '1 hour', '1 day', '1 week', '1 year', which set when cookies expire. Short.

page_expireIn1Hour.description: Full name of the '1 hour' expiry button. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_preset1Hour.description: Button: make the cookie expire 1 hour from now. Follows 'Expire in'. Very short.

page_expireIn1Day.description: Full name of the '1 day' expiry button. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_preset1Day.description: Button: make the cookie expire 1 day from now. Follows 'Expire in'. Very short.

page_expireIn1Week.description: Full name of the '1 week' expiry button. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_preset1Week.description: Button: make the cookie expire 1 week from now. Follows 'Expire in'. Very short.

page_expireIn1Year.description: Full name of the '1 year' expiry button. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_preset1Year.description: Button: make the cookie expire 1 year from now. Follows 'Expire in'. Very short.

page_pickedClear.description: Link-style button that unticks every ticked cookie. Short: a button label.

page_pickAll.description: Tooltip and name of the tick box at the top of the table that ticks every cookie.

page_colName.description: The cookie's name. Used as a column heading in several tables. Short: a table column heading.

page_sortBySize.description: Tooltip on the Value column heading: clicking it sorts by size.

page_colValue.description: The cookie's value. Short: a table column heading.

page_colSize.description: The cookie's size in bytes. Short: a table column heading.

page_colDomain.description: The site the cookie belongs to. Short: a table column heading.

page_colPath.description: The cookie's path, the part of the site it is sent to. Used in several tables. Short: a table column heading.

page_colExpires.description: When the cookie expires. Short: a table column heading.

page_colFlags.description: Column of small badges such as Secure and HttpOnly. Short: a table column heading. Read out by screen readers too.

page_colActions.description: Column of buttons on each row. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_emptyTable.message: No cookies are set for this site.
page_emptyTable.description: Shown in place of the table when the site has no cookies.

page_back.description: Button that goes back to the main screen. Used on every screen. Short: a button label.

page_editRuleNote.message: Your site rules block cookies on this site. You can still save one here, but the site won't be able to read it.
page_editRuleNote.description: Note in the cookie editor when the user's own rules block cookies on this site.

page_fieldName.description: Label of the cookie editor's Name box. Short.

page_copyNameTitle.description: Tooltip on the Copy button beside the name.

page_nameKnownNote.message: A guess from the name only. From the Open Cookie Database.
page_nameKnownNote.description: Small grey note under a known cookie's description. The Open Cookie Database is the name of a public list; leave it in English.

page_fieldValue.description: Label of the cookie editor's Value box. Short.

page_copyValueTitle.description: Tooltip on the Copy button beside the value.

page_editAsJson.message: Edit as JSON: laid out here, saved on one line
page_editAsJson.description: Tick box in the editor, for a value that is JSON. JSON is a format name; keep it.

page_decoded.description: Label above the value shown in a readable form (URL-decoded, Base64-decoded and so on). Short.

page_copyDecodedTitle.description: Tooltip on the Copy button beside the decoded value.

page_fieldDomain.description: Label of the cookie editor's Domain box. Short.

page_fieldPath.description: Label of the cookie editor's Path box. Short.

page_sameSiteUnset.description: Choice in the SameSite list: no SameSite attribute, so Chrome uses its default.

page_sameSiteNone.description: Choice in the SameSite list. Keep 'None' and 'Secure' in English: they are the attribute value and attribute name.

page_fieldExpires.description: Label of the editor's expiry date. Short.

page_sessionCheck.message: Session cookie: deleted when the browser closes
page_sessionCheck.description: Tick box in the editor: make it a session cookie.

page_fieldFlags.description: Label of the editor's group of tick boxes (Secure, HttpOnly, Host-only). Short.

page_secureCheck.description: Tick box in the editor. Keep 'Secure' and 'HTTPS' in English.

page_httpOnlyCheck.description: Tick box in the editor. Keep 'HttpOnly' in English.

page_hostOnlyCheck.message: Host-only: this exact host, not its subdomains
page_hostOnlyCheck.description: Tick box in the editor: the cookie is sent to this exact host only.

page_partitionedCheck.message: Partitioned (CHIPS): kept for only. Needs Secure.
page_partitionedCheck.description: Tick box in the editor, for a new cookie. The span holds a site, for example example.com. Keep 'Partitioned', 'CHIPS' and 'Secure' in English. Keep the exactly as it is; cookieZ puts the value into it.

page_editChanged.message: The site changed this cookie while you were editing. Saving will overwrite it.

page_copySetCookieTitle.message: Copy this cookie as the Set-Cookie line a server would send
page_copySetCookieTitle.description: Tooltip on the 'Copy as Set-Cookie' button. Set-Cookie is the HTTP header's name; keep it.

page_copySetCookie.description: Button that copies the cookie as a Set-Cookie header line. Keep 'Set-Cookie'. Short: a button label.

page_formatJsonNote.message: Compatible with other cookie editors. Keeps every detail.
page_formatJsonNote.description: Note beside the JSON export format.

page_formatPlaywrightNote.message: A storageState file, for starting a test already logged in.
page_formatPlaywrightNote.description: Note beside the Playwright export format (Playwright is a testing tool). Keep 'storageState': it is the file type's name.

page_formatSeleniumNote.message: Python add_cookie() calls, for a test. Can't hold partitions.
page_formatSeleniumNote.description: Note beside the Selenium export format (Selenium is a testing tool). Keep 'Python add_cookie()'.

page_formatNetscapeNote.message: For curl, wget, yt-dlp and other tools. Can't hold SameSite or partitions.
page_formatNetscapeNote.description: Note beside the cookies.txt export format. Keep the tool names curl, wget, yt-dlp, and 'SameSite'.

page_formatHeaderNote.message: Names and values only, for one site.
page_formatHeaderNote.description: Note beside the 'Cookie header' export format.

page_formatCurl.description: Export format: a curl command (curl is a program; keep its name). Short.

page_formatCurlNote.message: Sends these cookies to this page, for bash or zsh.
page_formatCurlNote.description: Note beside the curl export format. bash and zsh are program names.

page_exportOutputLabel.description: Name of the box showing the exported text. Read out by screen readers only, never shown.

page_exportPasswordLabel.description: Label of the optional password box on the export screen. Short.

page_exportPasswordNote.description: Note under the export password box.

page_reportHeading.description: Heading of the site report screen.

page_colWhatHappened.description: What happened to the cookie, such as Added or Removed. Short: a table column heading.

page_keptHeading.description: Heading of the screen listing every Kept cookie. 'Kept' is the same word as the badge and filter.

page_keptIntro.message: cookieZ leaves these out of every delete. This is the whole list it has saved, for every site: names, never values.

page_keptConfirmYes.description: Button that confirms 'Stop keeping all'. Short: a button label.

page_helpScopeQ.message: Which delete option should I pick?

page_helpScopeA.message: This page deletes the cookies this page gets. This domain and its subdomains also reaches subdomains, such as login.example.com. All sites deletes every cookie in this browser profile. The count and the sites are always shown first.
page_helpScopeA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons. The bold words are the choices in the delete area. login.example.com is an example address; keep it.

page_helpReportQ.message: What does a site store on me?

page_helpReportA.message: Site report, beside the cookie count, groups a site's cookies by purpose and lists anything worth checking. Each purpose is a guess from the cookie's name.
page_helpReportA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons.

page_helpLoginQ.message: Clearing cookies didn't let me log in

page_helpLoginA.message: Try Clear and reload under the delete options, then Clear and reload. As well as the site's cookies, it clears what else the site has stored: local storage, databases, cache storage and offline files. Kept cookies are left alone, and Undo can put the cookies back, but not the rest.
page_helpLoginA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons.

page_helpUndoQ.message: I deleted or changed the wrong cookies

page_helpUndoA.message: Click Undo in the message at the top. It works for 10 minutes after a delete, an import or a Save, even if you close cookieZ, and only for the most recent one.
page_helpUndoA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons. 'Undo' and 'Save' are button names. cookieZ is the product name.

page_helpLiveQ.message: Why did a row light up?
page_helpLiveQ.description: Question in the Help screen: rows in the table briefly highlight.

page_helpLiveA.message: The site, or cookieZ, has just added or changed that cookie. The table follows changes as they happen, so you don't need to press Refresh. Click changes next to the cookie count to see a list of what was added, changed, removed or expired since you opened cookieZ.
page_helpLiveA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons. 'changes' is the link beside the cookie count, as in '3 changes'.

page_helpKeptQ.description: Question in the Help screen. The bookmark is the icon on each row that marks a cookie as Kept.

page_helpKeptA.message: It marks a cookie as Kept, so cookieZ leaves it out of every delete, even "All sites". It doesn't stop the website changing or removing the cookie itself. To see every cookie you've kept, on any site, click Kept cookies under the delete options.
page_helpKeptA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons. 'All sites' is the delete choice of that name.

page_helpBlockQ.message: Can I stop a site setting cookies?

page_helpBlockA.message: Yes. Click Block at the top. For each site you can allow all cookies, have them cleared when Chrome closes, block other companies' cookies, or block every cookie. You can also block other companies' cookies on every site, or every cookie on every site except the ones you allow. Chrome does the blocking, so it works while cookieZ is closed, and removing cookieZ removes the rules. Chrome has its own switch for blocking other companies' cookies everywhere, in its settings; cookieZ doesn't change that.
page_helpBlockA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons.

page_helpBrokenQ.message: A site stopped working after I set a rule

page_helpBrokenA.message: Click Block on that site and choose Allow all cookies, or remove its rule from the list. Then reload the page.
page_helpBrokenA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons.

page_helpBadgesQ.description: Question in the Help screen. Badges are the small labels on each row, such as Secure.

page_helpBadgesA.message: Secure: only sent over HTTPS. HttpOnly: hidden from the page's own JavaScript. Subdomains: also sent to every subdomain. Partitioned: kept separately for each site it's used on. SameSite: when other sites can send it. Large: close to Chrome's 4 KB limit for one cookie.
page_helpBadgesA.description: Answer in the Help screen. Keep the <strong> tags around the same words as in your translation of those buttons. Keep Secure, HttpOnly, Partitioned, SameSite and HTTPS in English; translate Subdomains and Large as on the badges.

page_helpSizeQ.message: What's the size next to the cookie count?

page_helpSizeA.message: Roughly how much this site's cookies add to every request. Many servers refuse more than about 8 KB, which can stop you logging in, so cookieZ warns you above 6 KB.
page_helpSizeA.description: Answer in the Help screen. KB is kilobytes.

page_helpKeysQ.description: Heading of the keyboard shortcuts section of the Help screen.

page_keyOpen.message: Open cookieZ. Change it at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.
page_keyOpen.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what Alt+Shift+K does. Keep chrome://extensions/shortcuts as it is.

page_keySearch.message: Search the cookies. Start with name:, value:, domain: or path: to search that part only.
page_keySearch.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what / does. Keep name:, value:, domain: and path: in English: they are typed search prefixes.

page_keyAdd.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what N does.

page_keyMove.message: Move between cookies. <kbd>Home</kbd> and <kbd>End</kbd> jump to the first and last.
page_keyMove.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what the up and down arrows do. Keep the <kbd> tags and the key names inside them.

page_keyEdit.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what Enter does.

page_keyTick.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what Space does (ticks the cookie's tick box).

page_keyKeep.message: Keep it, or stop keeping it.
page_keyKeep.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what K does.

page_keyDelete.message: Delete it. It asks "Sure?" first: press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to delete.
page_keyDelete.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what Delete does. 'Sure?' is the question shown on the row. Keep the <kbd> tags and the key name inside them.

page_keyEsc.message: Go back from this screen, the editor, export, import or site rules, or cancel a delete or other question.
page_keyEsc.description: Help, keyboard shortcuts: what Esc does.

page_helpPanelQ.message: Can cookieZ stay open while I browse?

page_helpPanelA.message: Yes. Click More (the three dots at the top), then Open in side panel. cookieZ opens at the side of the window and shows the cookies of whichever tab you're on. It waits while you're editing, and catches up when you're back. The keyboard shortcuts work there too.
page_helpPanelA.description: Answer in the Help screen. 'More' and 'Open in side panel' are the button and menu item of those names; use the same words.

page_helpIncognitoQ.description: Heading in the Help screen. Use the word Chrome uses for incognito in your language.

page_helpIncognitoA.message: Turn on "Allow in incognito" on cookieZ's Details page in chrome://extensions. Incognito cookies are kept separate, and a delete in one never touches the other.
page_helpIncognitoA.description: Answer in the Help screen. 'Allow in incognito' and 'Details' are names on Chrome's extensions page; use Chrome's own words for them in your language.

page_helpContact.message: More help at cookiez.uk/support, or email support@cookiez.uk.
page_helpContact.description: Bottom of the Help screen. Keep the web address and email address exactly.

page_helpReview.message: If cookieZ helps you, a review in the Chrome Web Store helps other people find it.
page_helpReview.description: Bottom of the Help screen, before the 'Leave a review' button. cookieZ is the product name.

main_eventExpired.description: Short: a table cell in the What changed list. The cookie reached its expiry date and Chrome removed it.

main_eventExpiredOverwrite.message: Removed, by setting a date in the past
main_eventExpiredOverwrite.description: A table cell in the What changed list. The site removed the cookie by giving it an expiry date that has already passed.

main_eventEvicted.message: Removed by Chrome to make room
main_eventEvicted.description: A table cell in the What changed list. Chrome removed the cookie because the site had too many.

main_eventRemoved.description: Short: a table cell in the What changed list. The cookie was removed.

main_changesLink_one.description: Short: a link next to the cookie count that opens the What changed list, when $1 is 1.

main_changesLink_other.description: Short: a link next to the cookie count that opens the What changed list. $1 is a number such as 3.

main_whatsNew2_2_1.description: The What's new line, shown once at the top of the main screen the first time cookieZ opens after updating to version 2.2.1. Button and screen names in it (Block, Import, Site report, Clear and reload) should match those buttons' labels. name:session is search syntax and stays as it is.

main_whatsNew2_2_0.message: New: a tidier main screen with room for more cookies, and a Site report beside the cookie count.
main_whatsNew2_2_0.description: The What's new line, shown once at the top of the main screen the first time cookieZ opens after updating to version 2.2.0. Button and screen names in it (Block, Import, Site report, Clear and reload) should match those buttons' labels. name:session is search syntax and stays as it is.

main_whatsNew2_1_0.message: New: keep cookieZ open beside the page in Chrome's side panel, and Clear and reload for a site you can't log in to.
main_whatsNew2_1_0.description: The What's new line, shown once at the top of the main screen the first time cookieZ opens after updating to version 2.1.0. Button and screen names in it (Block, Import, Site report, Clear and reload) should match those buttons' labels. name:session is search syntax and stays as it is.

main_whatsNew2_0_0.message: New: search one field, such as name:session, and compare a site's cookies with an earlier export, from Import.
main_whatsNew2_0_0.description: The What's new line, shown once at the top of the main screen the first time cookieZ opens after updating to version 2.0.0. Button and screen names in it (Block, Import, Site report, Clear and reload) should match those buttons' labels. name:session is search syntax and stays as it is.

main_whatsNew1_9_0.message: New: block known trackers' cookies from Block, lock an export with a password, and reload the site after a change.
main_whatsNew1_9_0.description: The What's new line, shown once at the top of the main screen the first time cookieZ opens after updating to version 1.9.0. Button and screen names in it (Block, Import, Site report, Clear and reload) should match those buttons' labels. name:session is search syntax and stays as it is.

main_whatsNew1_8_0.message: New: block known trackers' cookies on every site, from Block. Cookies with a well-known name now say who they're from.
main_whatsNew1_8_0.description: The What's new line, shown once at the top of the main screen the first time cookieZ opens after updating to version 1.8.0. Button and screen names in it (Block, Import, Site report, Clear and reload) should match those buttons' labels. name:session is search syntax and stays as it is.

main_whatsNew1_7_0.message: New: the Block button at the top. You can now block other companies' cookies on every site, and clear a site's stored data as well as its cookies.
main_whatsNew1_7_0.description: The What's new line, shown once at the top of the main screen the first time cookieZ opens after updating to version 1.7.0. Button and screen names in it (Block, Import, Site report, Clear and reload) should match those buttons' labels. name:session is search syntax and stays as it is.

main_welcome.message: Welcome. Click a cookie to edit it. Can't log in to a site? Clear and reload usually fixes it. Help (?) explains the rest.
main_welcome.description: Welcome line shown once at the top of the main screen after installing. Clear and reload is a button's label, and Help (?) is the ? button in the header: use the same words as those.

main_welcomePin.message: Welcome. Click a cookie to edit it. Can't log in to a site? Clear and reload usually fixes it. Help (?) explains the rest. To keep cookieZ in reach, pin it from the puzzle piece in Chrome's toolbar.
main_welcomePin.description: The same welcome line as main_welcome, with a last sentence added when cookieZ isn't pinned to Chrome's toolbar. The puzzle piece is Chrome's Extensions button.

main_reviewNotNow.description: Short: a button on the line that asks for a store review, the first time it asks.

main_reviewNoThanks.description: Short: a button on the line that asks for a store review, the second and last time it asks.

main_reviewOpenFailed.description: Error when the Chrome Web Store review page wouldn't open. $1 is Chrome's own error text, in English.

main_copied.description: Short: replaces a copy button's label (or is read out by screen readers on an icon button) for a moment after copying worked.

main_copyFailed.description: Short: replaces a copy button's label for a moment when copying failed.

rules_nameAllow.description: One of the four choices for which cookies a site may set, on the Block cookies screen. Shown in the list of site rules and in messages. Short: a radio button label. This one lets the site set any cookie.

rules_nameSession.description: One of the four choices for which cookies a site may set, on the Block cookies screen. Shown in the list of site rules and in messages. Short: a radio button label. This one lets the site set cookies, and Chrome deletes them when the browser closes.

rules_nameOwnOnly.description: One of the four choices for which cookies a site may set, on the Block cookies screen. Shown in the list of site rules and in messages. Short: a radio button label. This one blocks third-party cookies: cookies from other companies (ad networks, trackers) on this site's pages. The site's own cookies are allowed.

rules_nameBlock.description: One of the four choices for which cookies a site may set, on the Block cookies screen. Shown in the list of site rules and in messages. Short: a radio button label. This one blocks every cookie on the site.

rules_lostCouldNotReapply.message: Chrome has stopped following your site rules, and cookieZ couldn't set them again. $1
rules_lostCouldNotReapply.description: Error on the main screen when the popup opens and finds Chrome has lost the saved site rules, and setting them again failed. $1 is the error sentence that follows, for example "Chrome wouldn't accept the rules: Invalid pattern."

rules_lostReapplied.message: Chrome had stopped following your site rules, so cookieZ has set them again.
rules_lostReapplied.description: Status line on the main screen when the popup opens and finds Chrome had lost the saved site rules, and has put them back.

rules_linkBlock.description: Short: the label of the button in the popup's header that opens the Block cookies screen (about 16 characters). Shown when nothing is blocked on this site; it's an action: open the screen to block cookies.

rules_linkBlockTitle.message: Choose which cookies this site may set
rules_linkBlockTitle.description: Tooltip on the Block cookies button in the popup's header. Shown when nothing is blocked on this site.

rules_linkSession.description: Short: the label of the button in the popup's header that opens the Block cookies screen (about 16 characters). Shown when this site's cookies are deleted when Chrome closes. Describes the state, not an action.

rules_linkSessionTitle.message: Chrome deletes this site's cookies when it closes
rules_linkSessionTitle.description: Tooltip on the Block cookies button in the popup's header. Shown when this site's cookies are deleted when Chrome closes.

rules_linkOwnOnly.description: Short: the label of the button in the popup's header that opens the Block cookies screen (about 16 characters). Shown when other companies' (third-party) cookies are blocked on this site. Describes the state, not an action.

rules_linkOwnOnlyTitle.message: Other companies' cookies are blocked on this site
rules_linkOwnOnlyTitle.description: Tooltip on the Block cookies button in the popup's header. Shown when third-party cookies are blocked on this site.

rules_linkBlocked.description: Short: the label of the button in the popup's header that opens the Block cookies screen (about 16 characters). Shown when every cookie is blocked on this site. Describes the state.

rules_linkBlockedTitle.message: Every cookie is blocked on this site
rules_linkBlockedTitle.description: Tooltip on the Block cookies button in the popup's header. Shown when every cookie is blocked on this site.

rules_linkTrackers.description: Short: the label of the button in the popup's header that opens the Block cookies screen (about 16 characters). Shown when known trackers' cookies are blocked on this site. Describes the state.

rules_linkTrackersTitle.message: Known trackers' cookies are blocked on this site
rules_linkTrackersTitle.description: Tooltip on the Block cookies button in the popup's header. Shown when known trackers' cookies are blocked on this site.

rules_linkLitAriaLabel.message: $1: choose which cookies this site may set
rules_linkLitAriaLabel.description: Screen reader label for the Block cookies button while something is blocked. $1 is the button's visible label, for example "Blocked" or "Clears on close".

rules_saving.description: Status line while Chrome takes in a change to the site rules, which can take a few seconds. Short.

rules_statsNoneCleared.message: cookieZ hasn't cleared any cookies yet.
rules_statsNoneCleared.description: Line at the top of the Block cookies screen, when cookieZ has never deleted a cookie. cookieZ is the product name.

rules_statsCleared_one.message: cookieZ has cleared $1 cookie so far.
rules_statsCleared_one.description: Line at the top of the Block cookies screen: how many cookies cookieZ has deleted, ever. $1 is the number, for example 1.

rules_statsCleared_other.message: cookieZ has cleared $1 cookies so far.
rules_statsCleared_other.description: Line at the top of the Block cookies screen: how many cookies cookieZ has deleted, ever. $1 is the number, for example 1,204.

rules_statsBlockingSitesAndTrackers_one.message: Blocking cookies on $1 site and from $2 known trackers.
rules_statsBlockingSitesAndTrackers_one.description: Second sentence of the line at the top of the Block cookies screen. $1 is the number of sites with a blocking rule (here 1). $2 is the number of known trackers on cookieZ's built-in list, for example 130; it is always large.

rules_statsBlockingSitesAndTrackers_othe.message: Blocking cookies on $1 sites and from $2 known trackers.
rules_statsBlockingSitesAndTrackers_othe.description: Second sentence of the line at the top of the Block cookies screen. $1 is the number of sites with a blocking rule, for example 3. $2 is the number of known trackers on cookieZ's built-in list, for example 130; it is always large.

rules_statsBlockingSites_one.description: Second sentence of the line at the top of the Block cookies screen. $1 is the number of sites with a blocking rule, here 1.

rules_statsBlockingSites_other.description: Second sentence of the line at the top of the Block cookies screen. $1 is the number of sites with a blocking rule, for example 3.

rules_statsBlockingTrackers_one.description: Second sentence of the line at the top of the Block cookies screen. $1 is the number of known trackers on cookieZ's built-in list.

rules_statsBlockingTrackers_other.description: Second sentence of the line at the top of the Block cookies screen. $1 is the number of known trackers on cookieZ's built-in list, for example 130.

rules_siteNote.message: This rule was set for $1, which covers $2 too.
rules_siteNote.description: Note under the site's name on the Block cookies screen, when the rule shown belongs to a parent site. $1 is the site with the rule, for example example.com. $2 is the site of the open page, for example shop.example.com.

rules_removeButton.description: Short: button in each row of the site rules table, removing that site's rule.

rules_removeAriaLabel.description: Screen reader label for the Remove button in the site rules table. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_thirdPartyControlled.message: Another extension or your administrator controls whether other companies' cookies are blocked, so cookieZ can't change it.
rules_thirdPartyControlled.description: Note under "On every other site" on the Block cookies screen, when Chrome's third-party cookie setting is locked by another extension or by policy.

rules_thirdPartyChromeBlocking.message: Chrome is already blocking other companies' cookies on every site, in its own settings.
rules_thirdPartyChromeBlocking.description: Note under "On every other site" on the Block cookies screen, when Chrome's own settings already block third-party cookies.

rules_permissionRefused.message: Chrome didn't give permission, so nothing has changed. The rest of cookieZ works as before.
rules_permissionRefused.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after the user said no to Chrome's permission prompt for site rules.

rules_permissionGivenReopen.message: Permission given. Close cookieZ and open it again to finish.
rules_permissionGivenReopen.description: Status line after the user gave a permission in Chrome's prompt, but Chrome needs the popup reopened before the feature works. Shown on the Block cookies screen and on the main screen.

rules_siteBlocked.message: All cookies are now blocked on $1.
rules_siteBlocked.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after choosing "Block all cookies" for a site. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_siteOwnOnly.message: Other companies' cookies are now blocked on $1.
rules_siteOwnOnly.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after choosing "Block other companies' cookies" for a site. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_siteSession.message: Chrome will delete $1's cookies every time it closes.
rules_siteSession.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after choosing "Clear when Chrome closes" for a site. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_siteAllowed.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after choosing "Allow all cookies" for a site. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_siteAllowedTrackersToo.message: $1 may set any cookie, known trackers' included.
rules_siteAllowedTrackersToo.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after choosing "Allow all cookies" for a site while known trackers are blocked everywhere else. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_cleanupSiteHas_one.description: Question text on the Block cookies screen after blocking a site, before buttons offering to delete the cookies it already has. "It" is the site just blocked. $1 is the number of cookies, here 1.

rules_cleanupSiteHas_other.description: Question text on the Block cookies screen after blocking a site, before buttons offering to delete the cookies it already has. "It" is the site just blocked. $1 is the number of cookies, for example 12.

rules_keptLeftAlone_one.message: $1 kept cookie will be left alone.
rules_keptLeftAlone_one.description: Sentence added after a delete offer or question. A kept cookie is one the user marked Keep, so no delete removes it. $1 is the number, here 1.

rules_keptLeftAlone_other.message: $1 kept cookies will be left alone.
rules_keptLeftAlone_other.description: Sentence added after a delete offer or question. A kept cookie is one the user marked Keep, so no delete removes it. $1 is the number, for example 2.

rules_cleanupTrackersHave_one.message: These companies already have $1 cookie saved.
rules_cleanupTrackersHave_one.description: Question text on the Block cookies screen after turning on blocking of known trackers, before buttons offering to delete the trackers' cookies already saved. $1 is the number, here 1.

rules_cleanupTrackersHave_other.message: These companies already have $1 cookies saved.
rules_cleanupTrackersHave_other.description: Question text on the Block cookies screen after turning on blocking of known trackers, before buttons offering to delete the trackers' cookies already saved. $1 is the number, for example 40.

rules_cleanupDeleted_one.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after deleting a blocked site's or trackers' cookies. $1 is the number, here 1.

rules_cleanupDeleted_other.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after deleting a blocked site's or trackers' cookies. $1 is the number, for example 12.

rules_cleanupFailed_one.message: $1 cookie could not be deleted, and may be protected by the browser.
rules_cleanupFailed_one.description: Error sentence after "Deleted 12 cookies." on the Block cookies screen, when some couldn't be deleted. $1 is the number, here 1.

rules_cleanupFailed_other.message: $1 cookies could not be deleted, and may be protected by the browser.
rules_cleanupFailed_other.description: Error sentence after "Deleted 12 cookies." on the Block cookies screen, when some couldn't be deleted. $1 is the number, for example 3.

rules_trackersOn.message: Known trackers' cookies are now blocked on every site.
rules_trackersOn.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after turning on the known trackers switch.

rules_trackersOff.message: Known trackers' cookies are no longer blocked on every site.
rules_trackersOff.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after turning off the known trackers switch.

rules_everywherePermissionRefused.message: Chrome didn't give permission, so nothing has changed. Your other rules work as before.
rules_everywherePermissionRefused.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after the user said no to Chrome's permission prompt for blocking other companies' cookies on every site.

rules_everywherePermissionGivenReopen.message: Permission given. Close cookieZ and open it again, then choose this again.
rules_everywherePermissionGivenReopen.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after the user gave the permission for blocking other companies' cookies on every site, but Chrome needs the popup reopened first. "This" is the choice they just clicked.

rules_everywhereBlocked.message: Cookies are now blocked on every site without a rule of its own.
rules_everywhereBlocked.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after choosing "Block all cookies" under "On every other site".

rules_everywhereOwnOnly.message: Other companies' cookies are now blocked on every site without a rule of its own.
rules_everywhereOwnOnly.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after choosing "Block other companies' cookies" under "On every other site".

rules_everywhereAllowed.message: Cookies are allowed again on every site without a rule of its own.
rules_everywhereAllowed.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after choosing "Allow all cookies" under "On every other site".

rules_siteDataPermissionRefused.message: Chrome didn't give permission, so nothing was cleared.
rules_siteDataPermissionRefused.description: Status line on the main screen after the user said no to Chrome's permission prompt for Clear site data.

rules_siteDataCountFailed.description: Error on the main screen when Clear site data can't read the site's cookies. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_siteDataConfirmCookies_one.message: Delete $1 cookie from $2 and clear everything else $2 has stored: local storage, databases, cache storage and offline files?
rules_siteDataConfirmCookies_one.description: Question before Clear site data runs, on the main screen. $1 is the number of cookies, here 1. $2 is the site, for example example.com. Local storage, databases, cache storage and offline files are the kinds of browser storage a website can use.

rules_siteDataConfirmCookies_other.message: Delete $1 cookies from $2 and clear everything else $2 has stored: local storage, databases, cache storage and offline files?
rules_siteDataConfirmCookies_other.description: Question before Clear site data runs, on the main screen. $1 is the number of cookies, for example 12. $2 is the site, for example example.com. Local storage, databases, cache storage and offline files are the kinds of browser storage a website can use.

rules_siteDataConfirmNoCookies.message: Clear everything else $1 has stored: local storage, databases, cache storage and offline files?
rules_siteDataConfirmNoCookies.description: Question before Clear site data runs, when the site has no cookies to delete. "Everything else" means everything besides cookies. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_siteDataUndoNote.message: Undo can put the cookies back, but not the rest.
rules_siteDataUndoNote.description: Last sentence of the question before Clear site data runs. Undo is the button that reverses the last change; it can't restore the site's other stored data.

rules_siteDataDeleted_one.message: Deleted $1 cookie and cleared $2's other stored data.
rules_siteDataDeleted_one.description: Status line on the main screen after Clear site data. $1 is the number of cookies deleted, here 1. $2 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_siteDataDeleted_other.message: Deleted $1 cookies and cleared $2's other stored data.
rules_siteDataDeleted_other.description: Status line on the main screen after Clear site data. $1 is the number of cookies deleted, for example 12. $2 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_siteDataCleared.description: Status line on the main screen after Clear site data, when the site had no cookies to delete. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_siteDataFailed_one.description: Error sentence added after the Clear site data result. $1 is the number, here 1.

rules_siteDataFailed_other.description: Error sentence added after the Clear site data result. $1 is the number, for example 3.

rules_siteDataError.description: Error sentence added after the Clear site data result, when Chrome failed to clear the site's non-cookie data. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_siteReloaded.description: Sentence added after the Clear site data result, after "Clear and reload".

rules_siteReloadFailed.description: Error sentence added after the Clear site data result, when the tab couldn't be reloaded. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_backupSaving.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after clicking Save a copy. $1 is the file name, cookiez-site-rules.json.

rules_backupReadFailed.description: Error on the Block cookies screen when a chosen rules backup file can't be read. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_backupNoteOwnOnly.message: It blocked other companies' cookies on every site; choose that again after loading.
rules_backupNoteOwnOnly.description: Sentence added to the question before loading a rules backup. "It" is the backup file. That choice needs a permission that can only be asked for from a click, so it isn't loaded.

rules_backupNoteTrackers.message: It also blocks known trackers' cookies.
rules_backupNoteTrackers.description: Sentence added to the question before loading a rules backup. "It" is the backup file.

rules_backupReplaceSites_one.message: Replace your rules with the $1 site in this file?
rules_backupReplaceSites_one.description: Question on the Block cookies screen before loading a rules backup. $1 is the number of sites with rules in the file, here 1.

rules_backupReplaceSites_other.message: Replace your rules with the $1 sites in this file?
rules_backupReplaceSites_other.description: Question on the Block cookies screen before loading a rules backup. $1 is the number of sites with rules in the file, for example 8.

rules_backupReplaceNoSites.message: Replace your rules with the ones in this file? It has no sites in it.
rules_backupReplaceNoSites.description: Question on the Block cookies screen before loading a rules backup that has no per-site rules (only the every-site settings).

rules_backupLoaded_one.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after loading a rules backup. $1 is the number of site rules, here 1.

rules_backupLoaded_other.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after loading a rules backup. $1 is the number of site rules, for example 8 (or 0).

rules_removed.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after removing a site's rule. $1 is the site, for example example.com.

rules_allOff.message: Every rule is off. Chrome is allowing cookies everywhere again.
rules_allOff.description: Status line on the Block cookies screen after Turn off all rules.

rules_loadFailed.description: Error when cookieZ's saved site rules can't be read from storage. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_saveFailed.description: Error when cookieZ's site rules can't be saved. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_noRulesPermission.message: Chrome hasn't given cookieZ permission to set rules.
rules_noRulesPermission.description: Error on the Block cookies screen when the permission for site rules is missing.

rules_noEverywherePermission.message: Chrome hasn't given cookieZ permission to block other companies' cookies on every site.
rules_noEverywherePermission.description: Error on the Block cookies screen when the permission for blocking third-party cookies on every site is missing.

rules_chromeRefused.description: Error on the Block cookies screen when Chrome refuses the site rules. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_backupNotJson.message: That file isn't a cookieZ rules backup: it isn't JSON.
rules_backupNotJson.description: Error on the Block cookies screen when the chosen file can't be read as a rules backup. JSON is a file format name; don't translate it.

rules_backupWrongKind.message: That file isn't a cookieZ rules backup.
rules_backupWrongKind.description: Error on the Block cookies screen when the chosen file is JSON but not a cookieZ rules backup.

rules_permissionNeedsClick.message: Chrome only allows the permission prompt to open from a direct click. Please click the button again.
rules_permissionNeedsClick.description: Error when Chrome refused to show its permission prompt because the request didn't come straight from a click.

rules_permissionPromptFailed.message: Chrome couldn't show the permission prompt: $1
rules_permissionPromptFailed.description: Error when Chrome couldn't show its permission prompt. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_keptLoadFailed.message: Couldn't read the protected list, so nothing is being treated as protected right now: $1
rules_keptLoadFailed.description: Error when the list of kept (protected) cookies can't be read from storage, so a delete could remove them. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_keptSaveFailed.description: Error when the list of kept (protected) cookies can't be saved. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_undoUnavailable.message: Undo isn't available for this change: $1
rules_undoUnavailable.description: Error after a change when its Undo can't be stored. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_undoCookie.description: How one cookie is named in a list of Undo failures. $1 is the cookie's name, for example sid. $2 is its site, for example example.com.

rules_undoRestoreFailed.description: One line in a list of cookies Undo couldn't put back. $1 is the cookie, for example "sid (example.com)". $2 is the reason, a sentence.

rules_undoRemoveFailed.description: One line in a list of cookies Undo couldn't take away. $1 is the cookie, for example "sid (example.com)".

rules_ageJustNow.description: Ends the sentence offering Undo for an earlier change: "Deleted 5 cookies just now." The code adds the full stop. Lower case, since it follows the start of the sentence.

rules_ageMinutes_one.description: Ends the sentence offering Undo for an earlier change: "Deleted 5 cookies 1 minute ago." The code adds the full stop. $1 is the number of minutes, here 1.

rules_ageMinutes_other.description: Ends the sentence offering Undo for an earlier change: "Deleted 5 cookies 4 minutes ago." The code adds the full stop. $1 is the number of minutes, 2 to 10.

rules_themeLoadFailed.message: Couldn't read your saved theme, so the system theme is being used: $1
rules_themeLoadFailed.description: Error when the saved light or dark theme choice can't be read. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

rules_themeSaveFailed.message: The theme changed, but couldn't be saved, so it will reset when you reopen the popup: $1
rules_themeSaveFailed.description: Error when the light or dark theme choice can't be saved. $1 is the browser's error text, in English.

cookie_expirySession.description: Short: the Expires column of the cookie table, for a cookie with no expiry date (deleted when the browser closes). One word if possible.

cookie_expiryUnknown.description: Short: the Expires column of the cookie table, when the expiry date can't be read. One word if possible.

cookie_expirySessionFull.message: Session cookie - removed when the browser closes
cookie_expirySessionFull.description: Tooltip on the Expires cell of a cookie with no expiry date.

cookie_expiryUnreadable.message: Expiry date could not be read
cookie_expiryUnreadable.description: Tooltip on the Expires cell when the cookie's expiry date can't be read.

cookie_expiresOn.description: Tooltip on the Expires cell of the cookie table. $1 is the date and time, formatted by the browser, possibly followed by how soon, e.g. "05/11/2026, 14:30:00" or "05/11/2026, 14:30:00 (in 3 days)".

cookie_expiryDateAndRelative.description: A cookie's expiry date with how soon that is. $1 is the date and time, e.g. "05/11/2026, 14:30:00"; $2 is the browser's own wording for how soon, e.g. "in 3 days". Change only the brackets, if your language writes this differently.

cookie_sameSiteUnset.description: Short: a cookie's SameSite setting when none was given. SameSite is a cookie attribute name; this word says it has no value. One word.

cookie_valueAsDateText.description: In the cookie editor, a cookie value that looks like a timestamp, shown as a date. $1 is the date and time in the browser's format, e.g. "Thu, 5 Nov 2026, 14:30:00". "Your time" means the user's own time zone.

cookie_valueAsDate.description: Short: label above the cookie editor's readable view of a value that is a timestamp, shown as a date.

cookie_valueFromBase64.description: Short: label above the cookie editor's readable view of a value that was Base64 and has been decoded. Base64 is a technical name; keep it.

cookie_valueDecoded.description: Short: label above the cookie editor's readable view of a value that was URL-encoded (%7B%22) and has been decoded.

cookie_valueLaidOut.description: Short: label above the cookie editor's readable view of a value that is JSON, shown spread over several indented lines.

cookie_valueNotJson.description: Error in the cookie editor when "Edit as JSON" is ticked and the value doesn't parse. $1 is the browser's own error message, in English, e.g. "Unexpected token } in JSON at position 12".

cookie_bytes_one.description: A size in bytes, in the cookie table and its tooltips. $1 is the number, e.g. "1".

cookie_bytes_other.description: A size in bytes, in the cookie table and its tooltips. $1 is the number, e.g. "812". Short: also used in a narrow table column.

cookie_kilobytes.description: A size in kilobytes, in the cookie table and its tooltips. $1 is the number, e.g. "3.1". KB is the unit; use your language's usual abbreviation.

cookie_knownByOthers_one.description: Who a cookie name is known to be used by, when the database lists it under more than one company. $1 is the number of other companies, e.g. "1"; $2 is the first company's name, e.g. "Didomi". Shown in a tooltip in the cookie table.

cookie_knownByOthers_other.description: Who a cookie name is known to be used by, when the database lists it under more than one company. $1 is the number of other companies, e.g. "3"; $2 is the first company's name, e.g. "Didomi". Shown in a tooltip in the cookie table.

cookie_kindFunctional.description: What a known cookie is for, as a word inside the sentence "Known name: Google, functional." (see cookie_knownNameKind). Lower case in English because it's mid-sentence.

cookie_kindAnalytics.description: What a known cookie is for, as a word inside the sentence "Known name: Google Analytics, analytics." (see cookie_knownNameKind). Lower case in English because it's mid-sentence.

cookie_kindMarketing.description: What a known cookie is for, as a word inside the sentence "Known name: Meta, marketing." (see cookie_knownNameKind). Lower case in English because it's mid-sentence.

cookie_kindSecurity.description: What a known cookie is for, as a word inside the sentence "Known name: Cloudflare, security." (see cookie_knownNameKind). Lower case in English because it's mid-sentence.

cookie_kindNecessary.description: What a known cookie is for (needed for the site to work), as a word inside the sentence "Known name: Shopify, necessary." (see cookie_knownNameKind). Lower case in English because it's mid-sentence.

cookie_kindPersonalisation.description: What a known cookie is for (remembering a user's choices to tailor the site), as a word inside the sentence "Known name: Hotjar, personalisation." (see cookie_knownNameKind). Lower case in English because it's mid-sentence.

cookie_knownNameKind.description: In the cookie editor, under the name field, when the cookie's name is in a public database of known cookies. $1 is the company it's listed under, e.g. "Google Analytics"; $2 is what it's for, one of the cookie_kind... words, e.g. "analytics". An English description from the database may follow.

cookie_knownName.description: In the cookie editor, under the name field, when the cookie's name is in a public database of known cookies and the database doesn't say what it's for. $1 is the company it's listed under, e.g. "Google Analytics".

cookie_knownAlsoListed.description: In the cookie editor, after "Known name: ...", when the database lists the name under more companies. $1 is a list of company names, e.g. "Didomi" or "Didomi, Sourcepoint and OneTrust".

cookie_listAnd.description: Joins the last name onto a list of names. $1 is one name or several separated by commas, e.g. "Google, Meta"; $2 is the last name, e.g. "TikTok". Gives "Google, Meta and TikTok".

cookie_errorNoName.description: Error in the cookie editor (or when importing) when the name is empty.

cookie_errorNameCharacters.message: A cookie name can't contain spaces, semicolons, commas or equals signs.
cookie_errorNameCharacters.description: Error in the cookie editor (or when importing) when the name has a character cookies don't allow.

cookie_errorValueSemicolon.message: A cookie value can't contain a semicolon.
cookie_errorValueSemicolon.description: Error in the cookie editor (or when importing) when the value has a semicolon.

cookie_errorTooBig.message: Chrome won't store a cookie bigger than $1 bytes (name and value together). This one is $2.
cookie_errorTooBig.description: Error in the cookie editor when the cookie is too big. $1 is the limit, e.g. "4,096"; $2 is this cookie's size in bytes, e.g. "5,210".

cookie_errorTooBigImported.message: Chrome won't store a cookie bigger than $1 bytes (name and value together). It is $2.
cookie_errorTooBigImported.description: Error shown for a cookie in a file being imported, when it's too big. $1 is the limit, e.g. "4,096"; $2 is the cookie's size in bytes, e.g. "5,210".

cookie_errorSecurePrefixImported.message: Its name starts with __Secure- but it isn't Secure, and Chrome won't accept that.
cookie_errorSecurePrefixImported.description: Error shown for a cookie in a file being imported. __Secure- is a name prefix and Secure a cookie attribute; keep both exactly.

cookie_errorSecurePrefix.message: A name starting with __Secure- only works on a Secure cookie. Tick Secure, or change the name.
cookie_errorSecurePrefix.description: Error in the cookie editor. __Secure- is a name prefix and Secure a cookie attribute (and the label of a tick box); keep both exactly.

cookie_hostPrefixSecure.description: One of the things a cookie whose name starts with __Host- must be, listed in cookie_errorHostPrefix's $1. Secure is a cookie attribute; normally kept as it is.

cookie_hostPrefixHostOnly.description: One of the things a cookie whose name starts with __Host- must be (sent to this exact host, not its subdomains), listed in cookie_errorHostPrefix's $1.

cookie_hostPrefixRootPath.description: One of the things a cookie whose name starts with __Host- must be, listed in cookie_errorHostPrefix's $1. "/" is the cookie path; keep it.

cookie_listOr.description: Joins two things a cookie isn't, in cookie_errorHostPrefix's $1. Each is one of cookie_hostPrefixSecure, cookie_hostPrefixHostOnly or cookie_hostPrefixRootPath, or an earlier join, e.g. "Secure or host-only".

cookie_errorHostPrefixImported.message: Its name starts with __Host-, so Chrome only accepts it if it is Secure, host-only and on the path /. It isn't $1.
cookie_errorHostPrefixImported.description: Error shown for a cookie in a file being imported. $1 is what it isn't, e.g. "Secure" or "host-only or on the path /". __Host- is a name prefix; keep it.

cookie_errorHostPrefix.message: A name starting with __Host- only works on a cookie that is Secure, host-only and on the path /. This one isn't $1.
cookie_errorHostPrefix.description: Error in the cookie editor. $1 is what this cookie isn't, e.g. "Secure" or "host-only or on the path /". __Host- is a name prefix; keep it.

cookie_errorNoDomain.description: Error in the cookie editor (or when importing) when the domain is empty.

cookie_errorPathSlash.message: The path has to start with a slash.
cookie_errorPathSlash.description: Error in the cookie editor (or when importing) when the cookie's path doesn't start with "/".

cookie_errorSameSiteNoneImported.message: It has SameSite “None” but isn't Secure, and Chrome won't accept that.
cookie_errorSameSiteNoneImported.description: Error shown for a cookie in a file being imported. SameSite, None and Secure are cookie attribute names and values; keep them.

cookie_errorSameSiteNone.message: SameSite “None” only works on a Secure cookie. Tick Secure, or choose a different SameSite.
cookie_errorSameSiteNone.description: Error in the cookie editor. SameSite, None and Secure are cookie attribute names and values (and labels in the form); keep them.

cookie_errorPartitionedImported.message: It's partitioned but isn't Secure, and Chrome won't accept that.
cookie_errorPartitionedImported.description: Error shown for a cookie in a file being imported. Partitioned (CHIPS) cookies are kept separately for each site. Secure is a cookie attribute; keep it.

cookie_errorPartitioned.message: A partitioned cookie only works when it's Secure. Tick Secure.
cookie_errorPartitioned.description: Error in the cookie editor. Partitioned (CHIPS) cookies are kept separately for each site. Secure is a cookie attribute and a tick box label; keep it.

cookie_errorNoExpiryImported.message: It has no expiry date and isn't marked as a session cookie.
cookie_errorNoExpiryImported.description: Error shown for a cookie in a file being imported.

cookie_errorNoExpiry.message: Set an expiry date, or tick “Session cookie”.
cookie_errorNoExpiry.description: Error in the cookie editor. “Session cookie” is the label of a tick box in the same form; use the same words as that label.

cookie_errorOriginalNotRemoved.message: The original cookie couldn't be removed, so the change was stopped rather than risk leaving two copies of it behind.
cookie_errorOriginalNotRemoved.description: Error in the cookie editor when saving a cookie whose name, domain or path was changed, which means deleting the old one first, and that failed.

cookie_errorNotAccepted.message: Chrome didn't accept the cookie, and didn't say why.
cookie_errorNotAccepted.description: Error in the cookie editor when Chrome refused to save a cookie without giving a reason.

cookie_errorParseOrSet.message: $1 This usually means the domain doesn't match the cookie, or the name or value contains a character cookies aren't allowed to carry.
cookie_errorParseOrSet.description: Error in the cookie editor when Chrome refused a cookie. $1 is Chrome's own error, in English, ending with a full stop, e.g. "Failed to parse or set cookie named \"a\".". The rest explains the usual reasons.

cookie_editTitleEdit.description: Short: heading of the cookie editor screen when editing an existing cookie.

cookie_editTitleNew.description: Short: heading of the cookie editor screen when creating a cookie.

cookie_editPartitionEmbedded.message: Set by $1 in a frame on this site, and kept for this site only (a partitioned, or CHIPS, cookie). Its partition is kept as it is when you save.
cookie_editPartitionEmbedded.description: Note in the cookie editor for a cookie another site set from inside a frame on this one. $1 is that site's domain, e.g. "widget.example". CHIPS is a technical name; keep it.

cookie_editPartitioned.message: This is a partitioned (CHIPS) cookie. Its partition is kept as it is when you save.
cookie_editPartitioned.description: Note in the cookie editor for a partitioned cookie (one kept separately for each site). CHIPS is a technical name; keep it.

cookie_editValueSize.description: Note under the value in the cookie editor, once the cookie is close to Chrome's size limit. $1 is its size, e.g. "3,612"; $2 is the limit, e.g. "4,096".

cookie_editExpiryShortened.message: Chrome shortened the expiry to $1 It limits how far ahead a cookie is allowed to expire.
cookie_editExpiryShortened.description: Added after "Saved changes to ..." or "Created ..." when Chrome moved the expiry date closer. $1 is the date and time it now expires, e.g. "05/11/2027, 14:30:00". The English has no full stop after $1; you may add one.

cookie_editJsonFixIt.message: $1 Fix it, or untick "Edit as JSON" to save it as typed.
cookie_editJsonFixIt.description: Error in the cookie editor when saving a value that doesn't parse as JSON. $1 is cookie_valueNotJson, e.g. "The value isn't valid JSON: Unexpected end of JSON input.". "Edit as JSON" is the label of a tick box in the same form; use the same words as that label.

cookie_editSaved.description: Status line on the main screen after saving an edited cookie. $1 is the cookie's name, e.g. "session_id".

cookie_editCreated.description: Status line on the main screen after creating a cookie. $1 is the cookie's name, e.g. "session_id".

cookie_rowNameTitle.description: Tooltip on a cookie's name in the table. $1 is the name, e.g. "_ga"; $2 is its size, e.g. "40 bytes". Change only the brackets, if your language writes this differently.

cookie_rowEmbeddedNote.message: set in a frame, kept for this site only
cookie_rowEmbeddedNote.description: Small note under the domain in the cookie table, for a cookie another site set from inside a frame on this one (a partitioned cookie). Lower case in English. Keep it short.

cookie_rowEmbeddedNoteTitle.message: Set by $1 in a frame on this site. It's partitioned, so it's kept for this site only.
cookie_rowEmbeddedNoteTitle.description: Tooltip on cookie_rowEmbeddedNote. $1 is the other site's domain, e.g. "widget.example".

cookie_rowPickLabel.description: Screen reader label of the tick box at the start of each table row, used to choose cookies. $1 is the cookie's name, e.g. "_ga".

cookie_rowCopyName.description: Short: a small icon button on a table row that copies the cookie's name. Read out by screen readers and shown as a tooltip.

cookie_rowCopyNameTitle.description: Tooltip on the Copy name button. $1 is the cookie's name, e.g. "_ga".

cookie_rowKept.description: Short: label of a row's Keep button when the cookie is already kept (cookieZ won't delete it). One word, read out by screen readers.

cookie_rowKeep.description: Short: label of a row's Keep button: mark the cookie so cookieZ never deletes it. One word, read out by screen readers.

cookie_rowKeptTitle.message: Kept: left out of every delete. Click to stop keeping it.
cookie_rowKeptTitle.description: Tooltip on a row's Keep button when the cookie is kept. Uses the word from cookie_rowKept.

cookie_rowKeepTitle.message: Keep: leave this cookie out of every delete made here
cookie_rowKeepTitle.description: Tooltip on a row's Keep button when the cookie isn't kept. Uses the word from cookie_rowKeep.

cookie_rowEdit.description: Short: label of a row's Edit icon button, read out by screen readers. One word.

cookie_rowEditTitle.description: Tooltip on a row's Edit button.

cookie_rowDelete.description: Short: label of a row's Delete icon button, read out by screen readers. One word.

cookie_rowDeleteKeptTitle.message: Kept cookies aren't deleted. Click the bookmark to allow it.
cookie_rowDeleteKeptTitle.description: Tooltip on a row's Delete button when it's disabled because the cookie is kept. The bookmark is the Keep button's icon.

cookie_rowDeleteTitle.description: Tooltip on a row's Delete button.

cookie_rowDontDelete.description: Short: label of the cancel (cross) button shown next to "Sure?" after Delete is clicked once. Read out by screen readers.

cookie_rowSure.description: Short: a row's Delete button changes to this after the first click; clicking again deletes the cookie. Very tight space: one or two words.

cookie_rowValueEmpty.description: Short: shown greyed in the Value column of the table when a cookie's value is empty.

cookie_rowValueCopy.description: Short: a small button under a cookie's value once it's shown in full in the table. One word.

cookie_rowValueCollapse.description: Tooltip on a long cookie value in the table when it's shown in full.

cookie_rowValueExpand.message: Click to show the full value
cookie_rowValueExpand.description: Tooltip on a long cookie value in the table when it's cut short.

cookie_badgeSecureTitle.description: Tooltip on the "Secure" badge in the table's Flags column. Secure is a cookie attribute and stays in English.

cookie_badgeHttpOnlyTitle.message: Hidden from the page's own JavaScript
cookie_badgeHttpOnlyTitle.description: Tooltip on the "HttpOnly" badge in the table's Flags column. HttpOnly is a cookie attribute and stays in English.

cookie_badgeSubdomains.description: Short: a badge in the table's narrow Flags column, for a cookie that is also sent to every subdomain. One word.

cookie_badgeSubdomainsTitle.message: Also sent to every subdomain of $1
cookie_badgeSubdomainsTitle.description: Tooltip on the Subdomains badge. $1 is the cookie's domain, e.g. "example.com".

cookie_badgePartitionedEmbeddedTitle.message: Partitioned (CHIPS): set by $1 and kept for this site only
cookie_badgePartitionedEmbeddedTitle.description: Tooltip on the "Partitioned" badge for a cookie another site set from inside a frame on this one. $1 is that site's domain, e.g. "widget.example". Partitioned and CHIPS are technical names; keep them.

cookie_badgePartitionedTitle.message: Partitioned (CHIPS): kept separately for each site it's used on
cookie_badgePartitionedTitle.description: Tooltip on the "Partitioned" badge in the table's Flags column. Partitioned and CHIPS are technical names; keep them.

cookie_badgeKnownTitle.message: Known name, used by $1. A guess from the name only.
cookie_badgeKnownTitle.description: Tooltip on the Known badge. $1 is who uses this cookie name, e.g. "Google Analytics" or "Didomi and 2 others" (cookie_knownByOthers).

cookie_badgeKnown.description: Short: a badge in the table's narrow Flags column, for a cookie whose name is in a public database of known cookies. Not "tracker": it's only a guess from the name. One word.

cookie_badgeKnownHidden.description: Read out by screen readers straight after the Known badge (cookie_badgeKnown), so together they say "Known name, used by Google Analytics". Not shown on screen. $1 is who uses the name, e.g. "Google Analytics".

cookie_badgeLarge.description: Short: a badge in the table's narrow Flags column, for a cookie close to Chrome's 4 KB size limit. One word.

cookie_badgeLargeTitle.message: $1. Chrome won't keep a cookie over 4 KB (name and value together).
cookie_badgeLargeTitle.description: Tooltip on the Large badge. $1 is the cookie's size, e.g. "3.6 KB".

cookie_badgeSameSiteStrictTitle.message: Only sent when you're on this site
cookie_badgeSameSiteStrictTitle.description: Tooltip on the "SameSite Strict" badge in the table's Flags column. The badge itself stays in English.

cookie_badgeSameSiteLaxTitle.message: Sent on this site, and when you follow a link to it
cookie_badgeSameSiteLaxTitle.description: Tooltip on the "SameSite Lax" badge in the table's Flags column. The badge itself stays in English.

cookie_badgeSameSiteNoneTitle.message: Also sent when another site loads something from this one
cookie_badgeSameSiteNoneTitle.description: Tooltip on the "SameSite None" badge in the table's Flags column. The badge itself stays in English.

cookie_reportPurposeMarketing.description: Site report: a row heading in the table of what the site's cookies are for. Keep it short.

cookie_reportPurposeAnalytics.description: Site report: a row heading in the table of what the site's cookies are for (measuring visits). Keep it short.

cookie_reportPurposePersonalisation.description: Site report: a row heading in the table of what the site's cookies are for (remembering choices to tailor the site). Keep it short.

cookie_reportPurposeFunctional.description: Site report: a row heading in the table of what the site's cookies are for (features of the site itself). Keep it short.

cookie_reportPurposeSecurity.description: Site report: a row heading in the table of what the site's cookies are for. Keep it short.

cookie_reportPurposeNecessary.description: Site report: a row heading in the table of what the site's cookies are for. Keep it short.

cookie_reportCompaniesOthers_one.description: Site report: the companies behind one row's cookies, when there are more than fit. $1 is how many more, e.g. "1"; $2 is the first few names, e.g. "Google, Meta, TikTok".

cookie_reportCompaniesOthers_other.description: Site report: the companies behind one row's cookies, when there are more than fit. $1 is how many more, e.g. "2"; $2 is the first few names, e.g. "Google, Meta, TikTok".

cookie_reportNotRecognised.description: Site report: the row for cookies whose names aren't in the database of known cookies. Keep it short.

cookie_reportCheckNotSecure.description: Site report, "worth checking" table: a row heading for cookies without the Secure flag.

cookie_reportCheckNotSecureNote.message: They don't have the Secure flag.
cookie_reportCheckNotSecureNote.description: Site report: the small note under cookie_reportCheckNotSecure. Secure is a cookie attribute; keep it.

cookie_reportCheckReadable.description: Site report, "worth checking" table: a row heading for cookies without the HttpOnly flag.

cookie_reportCheckReadableNote.message: They don't have the HttpOnly flag.
cookie_reportCheckReadableNote.description: Site report: the small note under cookie_reportCheckReadable. HttpOnly is a cookie attribute; keep it.

cookie_reportCheckSameSiteNone.message: Sent when another site loads this one
cookie_reportCheckSameSiteNone.description: Site report, "worth checking" table: a row heading for cookies with SameSite None.

cookie_reportCheckSameSiteNoneNote.description: Site report: the small note under cookie_reportCheckSameSiteNone. SameSite and None are a cookie attribute and its value; keep them.

cookie_reportCheckLarge.description: Site report, "worth checking" table: a row heading for very large cookies.

cookie_reportCheckLargeNote.message: A site with too many of these can stop logins working.
cookie_reportCheckLargeNote.description: Site report: the small note under cookie_reportCheckLarge.

cookie_reportCheckSoon.description: Site report, "worth checking" table: a row heading for cookies that expire within 24 hours.

cookie_reportCheckSoonNote.message: A sign-in held in one of these won't last.
cookie_reportCheckSoonNote.description: Site report: the small note under cookie_reportCheckSoon.

cookie_reportShowThem.description: Short: a button in each row of the site report's "worth checking" table; it goes back to the cookie table filtered to those cookies.

cookie_reportShowThemLabel_one.description: Screen reader label of the Show them button. $1 is the number of cookies, e.g. "1"; $2 is the row heading, e.g. "Expire within a day".

cookie_reportShowThemLabel_other.description: Screen reader label of the Show them button. $1 is the number of cookies, e.g. "4"; $2 is the row heading, e.g. "Expire within a day".
